title: FloodGuard planning protocol v1b (engineering addendum)
description: Shape of docs/proposal_execution/planning_protocol_v1b.json. While any open item is open the status must be incomplete_draft. A file with status draft_for_signature or signed has no open item, every section fixed and every parameter that an open item names filled in ($defs/fixed_parameters). A signed file also has both signatures, by two different named signers, every drafter reading confirmed or amended, the recorded v1a SHA-256 and an owner's acceptance of the compute window of the corridor run of record (corridor_polygon.run_of_record.compute_window.owner_acceptance). The file never records its own SHA-256.

fixed_parameters.description: Every parameter that an open item names is present and not null. Generated from the parameter_pointers of the open items; a test checks that the two stay in step.

acceptance.description: Plan acceptance values that must hold before signing: at least 4 hospitals in the context, the three named hospital ways inside the routing context, baseline no-route share of at most 10 percent, and an exact match in the permissive closure regression.

se2_blind_unit_list.description: COD-AB tha_admin3 codes of the SE2-blind units, or one sentence saying the case was dropped under a cut line.

owner_acceptance.description: Filled by an owner, never by the agent: whether the owner accepts the compute window the agent declared for the corridor run of record.

owner_answer.description: An owner answer recorded in the decision log and written into some of the item's parameters before the rest of the item is produced. The item stays open until every parameter it names is filled; it then closes in one edit with a closure object. A test checks that every pointer listed here is one of the item's parameter_pointers and is filled, and that an owner-decision slot of an open item is filled only when it is listed here.

agent_note.description: Written by the agent, not the owners: what the owners left unanswered and what the file does by default.
